model_note: DeepSeek-V4.1-1017 served through the penguin-go OpenAI-compatible gateway under model id `deepseek-1017` (`client_type=deepseek-v4`, `context_window=1048576`, `max_output_tokens=65536`). Both Baseten list-price equivalents ($0.30/$0.007/$1.20 per 1M tokens) and actual provider-billed USD (`penguin cost --by session`, $0.2857/$0.005714/$1.1429 per 1M tokens) are reported.
prompt: Stock PenguinHarness 0.2.18 default_agent system prompt (zero custom AGENTS.md, zero custom skills, zero task-specific prompt rules)

runner.name: Harbor
runner.isolation: local Docker Engine 29.1.3 / Docker Compose v5.0.0 on Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS (Linux 6.8.0-90-generic x86_64, dual Intel Xeon Platinum 8358P, 128 threads, 1.0 TiB RAM)
runner.agent_invocation: penguin run -m "<instruction>" --workspace <cwd> --project-id default_project --agent-id default_agent --provider penguin-go --model-id deepseek-1017 --thinking max --approve allow-all --source benchmark --json (with PB_MAX_TURNS=-1 and run_timeout=unlimited so Harbor enforces the native task.toml agent.timeout_sec)

task_source: frontier-harness-eval/frontier-harness-eval@v1.1.0 (62 tasks: 45 from Terminal-Bench 2, 17 introduced in v1.1)
task_resources: as declared per task in task.toml
agent_timeout: native task.toml agent.timeout_sec (timeout_multiplier = 1.0, run_timeout = unlimited inside agent so Harbor enforces task.toml timeout)
canonical: all 4 rounds (R1, R2, R3, R4) across all 62 tasks (248 scored trials); primary score is per-attempt pass rate (170 / 248 = 68.55%), with per-round rates and Pass@4 also reported

cost_conversion.formula: uncached_input * input + cached_input * cached_input + output * output, per million tokens
cost_conversion.prices_source: Baseten list price for deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 ($0.30 / $0.007 / $1.20 per 1M tokens) for direct cross-harness comparison, plus exact provider-billed USD recorded by `penguin cost --by session` ($0.2857 / $0.005714 / $1.1429 per 1M tokens).
cost_conversion.aggregation: exact sum and per-trial metrics across all 248 scored trials (62 tasks x 4 rounds), including all delegated subagent sessions
cost_conversion.sandbox: local Docker on bare-metal Linux server (sandbox_usd = 0)

protocol_deviations: 4 complete rounds (248 scored trials across 62 tasks) were executed; the headline score is the per-attempt pass rate across all 248 scored trials (170 / 248 = 68.55%), alongside each individual round (R1: 43/62 = 69.35%, R2: 43/62 = 69.35%, R3: 42/62 = 67.74%, R4: 42/62 = 67.74%) and Pass@4 (50 / 62 = 80.65%).

Model is DeepSeek-V4.1-1017 served via the penguin-go OpenAI-compatible gateway (`penguin-go/deepseek-1017`) rather than Baseten Kimi K2.5 / GPT-5.4 / Claude Opus 4.6; costs are reported both at Baseten list price ($0.30/$0.007/$1.20 per 1M tokens) and actual provider billing.
Trials ran on a local Docker host (Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, Linux 6.8.0-90-generic x86_64) rather than Runta cloud sandboxes.

For the 7 tasks whose upstream `test.sh` attempts to download `uv 0.9.5` and pytest wheels inside a network-isolated verifier container (`filter-js-from-html`, `fix-ocaml-gc`, `large-scale-text-editing`, `mailman`, `polyglot-c-py`, `pypi-server`, `sam-cell-seg`), `RecoveryVerifier` injected a pre-fetched offline `uv 0.9.5` + wheel cache (`verifier-deps.tar.gz`) strictly after the agent phase completed and ran the unmodified upstream `test.sh` (`test_script_modified=false`, `assertions_modified=false`, `agent_environment_preseeded=false`).

For `bun-sourcemap-leak`, whose task image sets `ENTRYPOINT ["docker-entrypoint.sh"]` without `/usr/local/bin` in Harbor's container `PATH`, a Docker Compose override (`bun-entrypoint.json`) set `entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh"]` so the container could boot under Harbor.
